title: A summarizing memory's summarizer reads a person whose name is one of the labels a model reads as its own turns (You, assistant, user) with "(a participant)" after the name
notes: Python: memory/_summary.py SummaryLines reads channels/_speaker.py turn_speakers, whose _ranked adds ' (a participant)' to a name whose skeleton is one of the labels a model reads as its own turns or a one-to-one user's (RMK-1435). The summarizing memory and its numbers are memory/a-summary-stands-for-the-older-turns's; the first sender is named You, the second Alice. Only the summarizer's request is compared.
